goal: Reconcile the previously authorized current Codex Desktop task into the repository-external private archive under the current Development Policy, then verify raw and verbatim integrity without capturing Claude or historical Codex sessions.

supersedes.reason: The version 1 contract is active_stale because its fixed Development Policy digest no longer matches the current authority. Existing private artifacts remain preserved and are used only as the verified append prefix.

authorized_source.selector: the currently preserved Codex Desktop task rollout only

in_scope: validate the existing raw archive, private verbatim transcript, durable cursor, private provenance, and integrity ledger
verify that the existing raw archive is an exact prefix of the current Codex rollout
append the available bytes for the one authorized current Codex rollout exactly once
regenerate the private verbatim transcript from the complete preserved raw range
update the durable cursor, private provenance, and integrity ledger after artifact verification
verify UTF-8, JSONL parsing, event counts, tool call/result pairing, digests, permissions, and absence of temporary files
write value-safe repository Evidence without transcript content or private absolute paths
out_of_scope: historical Codex session discovery or capture
hook, watcher, scheduler, service, or background automation activation
retention deletion, backup, or application-layer encryption
Git storage of private transcript artifacts
acceptance: all fixed source digests match the current working tree before capture
the existing preserved raw is an exact byte prefix of the authorized source
the manual reconcile reports updated or unchanged without divergence, parse failure, or unsupported source
the immediate identical rerun reports unchanged and writes no duplicate bytes or events
the regenerated verbatim transcript matches the stored transcript byte-for-byte
raw, verbatim, cursor, provenance, and ledger digests agree after reread
all parsed tool calls that have results in the captured source are paired, and any terminal unpaired call is explicitly reported as a live-boundary limitation
private output remains outside the repository with directories 0700 and files 0600
no transcript value or private absolute path is written to repository Evidence
the existing Claude worktree changes remain untouched
stop_conditions: the existing archive is not a prefix of the source
the source identity or relative path differs from the authorized rollout
a private output may enter the repository or Git boundary
Claude or historical Codex sources would be captured
the collector reports divergence, parse failure, unsupported source, or artifact checkpoint failure
the repository worktree changes outside this contract scope
recovery: preserve the last valid raw and cursor on write failure
rerun from the durable cursor after interruption
record divergence without overwriting the archive
regenerate derived artifacts from preserved raw
stop and request Human review when the authorized source is unavailable or no longer prefix-compatible
implementation_order: verify fixed sources and the existing private checkpoint
verify source identity and byte-prefix compatibility
run one manual reconcile from an executor outside the Codex task being captured
reread raw, verbatim, cursor, provenance, and ledger and verify aggregate integrity
